This placard indicates a long commercial vehicle, which is a double trailer and can be up to 40 metres in length. statements.force_from: context (Regulatory signs: "These signs give a direction that must be obeyed")
statements.text: a driver MUST NOT pass on the road WHEN a "do not pass" sign is posted for the road

sources.quote: Do not pass on this road.

statements.note: The legal force comes from the section introduction for Regulatory signs. The figure is included as the visual reference for the sign.

statements.text: a driver of slow traffic MUST keep right WHEN driving on a multi-lane road AND a "slow traffic keep right" sign is posted

sources.quote: Slow traffic on multi-lane roads must keep right.

statements.note: The sign caption specifies the condition (multi-lane roads) and the duty (keep right). The role is specified as a driver of slow traffic.

statements.force_from: context (Regulatory signs: "These signs give a direction that must be obeyed")
statements.text: a driver MUST keep to the right lane WHEN driving on a two-lane section where climbing or passing lanes are provided UNLESS the driver is passing

sources.quote: Keep to the right lane except when passing on two-lane sections where climbing or passing lanes are provided.

statements.note: The legal force comes from the section introduction for Regulatory signs. The exception for passing is written as an UNLESS clause.

statements.text: FACT the downward lines on a warning sign show the side on which a driver may safely pass

sources.quote: The downward lines show the side on which you may safely pass.

statements.note: This is a description of what the sign indicates, not a direct instruction or prohibition, so it is a FACT.

statements.force_from: context (Temporary condition signs: implied legal force for temporary traffic control)
statements.text: a driver MUST NOT pass a pilot vehicle or pace vehicle WHEN the vehicle is bearing a "do not pass" sign

sources.quote: Do not pass the pilot vehicle or pace vehicle bearing this sign.

statements.note: Temporary condition signs are regulatory in nature. The figure is included as the visual reference for the sign.

statements.text: a driver SHOULD recognize a long commercial vehicle on the highway based on rear signage AND anticipate the extended length and limited speed WHEN the driver is preparing to pass the long commercial vehicle on the highway

sources.quote: It is important to be able to recognize an LCV on the highway, based on rear signage, and anticipate both the extended length and limited speed when preparing to pass one on the highway.

statements.note: The phrase 'It is important to' indicates advice. The definition of LCV is not included as a separate statement because the focus here is on the passing behavior.
